usedFor: Webinargeek holds webinar sign-ups, and FreeAgent gets a to-do when “New Registration” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Webinargeek, then “Create Task” in FreeAgent
bestTemplate.why: Each sign-up becomes a task in a FreeAgent project, so someone follows up with the registrant.

watchOut: “Create Task” in FreeAgent needs a project, and “New Registration” is polling, so a short delay is normal.
